'''''Star Wars: Knight Errant''''' was a series of [[Star Wars comic books|comics]] set in the [[Old Republic era]]. This comic series is set during the [[Republic Dark Age]], the last century of the [[New Sith Wars]]. ''Knight Errant'' focuses on the adventures of [[Kerra Holt]], a young [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] woman, in the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]-controlled [[Grumani sector/Legends|Grumani sector]]. The comic series also devotes a large part of its plot to examining the multiple [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Warlord/Legends|warlords]] that established princedoms throughout the [[Galaxy/Legends|Galaxy]] during the [[Republic Dark Age]]. This plot element was first introduced in [[Daniel Wallace]]'s [[2005]] reference book ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.

In [[July]] [[2012]], [[Randy Stradley]] announced on the Dark Horse message boards that the series would end after the third story arc.<ref name="DHmb" />
